_comment: Offline vulnerability database for the build-free supply-chain lane. A small, curated OSV-shaped slice carried in the bundle; the sneakernet kit refreshes it. Each entry: ecosystem, package, an advisory id, CWE, severity, the vulnerable version range (inclusive lower, exclusive upper), and the first fixed version used by the dependency-bump patch lane. The full product carries the OSV offline mirror; this file is enough to prove the lane end to end on every ecosystem.

advisories.summary: Log4Shell: remote code execution via JNDI message lookup
Deeply nested JSON causes a stack overflow (DoS)
Arbitrary code execution via full_load / unsafe load
HTTP header smuggling via X-Forwarded-For handling
